intent: Mask the genotype calls whose genotype quality (GQ) is below 20, so that they count as missing downstream, and keep all the sites.
silent_error: gatk VariantFiltration --genotype-filter-expression only writes the filter name into FORMAT/FT; the GT field of the failing genotypes is left untouched unless --set-filtered-genotype-to-no-call is added. Every tool that reads GT (bcftools, vcftools, plink) still sees all the low-GQ calls as called genotypes. Exit 0, no message about the unchanged genotypes. Documented in the GATK tool documentation of VariantFiltration (--set-filtered-genotype-to-no-call).
